name: United Kingdom

items.label: Personal allowance
items.note: Withdrawn by £1 for every £2 of income over £100,000, which is what creates the 60% effective band up to £125,140.

items.label: Income tax
items.note: Thresholds are on taxable income, i.e. after the personal allowance.

items.label: National Insurance
items.note: Class 1 employee contributions, charged on gross pay rather than taxable income. Weekly thresholds of £241.73 and £966.73 are £12,570 and £50,270 a year.

brackets: Primary threshold to upper earnings limit

assumptions: Standard tax code (1257L) and personal allowance
Employment income only, paid evenly through the year
notModelled: Student loan and postgraduate loan repayments
Tax codes other than the standard personal allowance
Benefits in kind, salary sacrifice and taxable expenses
Blind person's allowance, marriage allowance and other reliefs
